## What changed

Describe the change and the compliance or operational problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes

## Privacy and security

- [ ] This change does not collect new endpoint data
- [ ] Any new collected field is documented with purpose, source, retention, and redaction behavior
- [ ] No credentials, production data, or sensitive logs are included
